intro.title: Syncopation
intro.text: Syncopation puts notes between the clicks and holds them across the beat. “1 & (2) & 3”: the quarter note in bar 1 starts on the “&” of 1 and covers beat 2.

intro.title: Feel it
intro.text: The left hand keeps the beat in quarters: lock onto it, and let the right hand push against it.
